subject: Private deployment intake — MOP & environment governance roadmap
messages:
From: Matt Holmes <matt.holmes@lumacorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+proc@lumacorp.com
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment intake: network & governance overview

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this. We are kicking off a private deployment (VPC + on-prem edge) evaluation for an internally regulated analytics workload and want to map out the network gate, MOP, and governance expectations up front.

High level:
- Target environment: hybrid (primary VPC in us-east-1 + two on-prem edge boxes)
- Data classification: PII + internal analytics
- Hard constraints: no external storage of raw PII; strict ingress/egress rules

Can your team share the intake checklist and a suggested method-of-procedure (MOP) for port/opening requests, service accounts, and key rotation? I'll attach our internal intake workbook in a follow-up.

Proposed timeline: 2–3 week runway for environment validation and smoke tests.

Cc'ing ops+proc so they can add any required artifacts.

Thanks,
Matt
Matt Holmes
IT Ops Lead, LumaCorp

---
(Attachment stub: Luma_MAP_v1.xlsx — spreadsheet with high-level milestones and owners)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Holmes <matt.holmes@lumacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2024 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake: network & governance overview

Hi Matt —

Appreciate the overview. Attaching our suggested MOP for network gating (mop-network-ports.json) and a short intake checklist. Quick notes inline:

- Timeline: 2 weeks from "environment provisioned" for basic validation; allow an extra week for KMS/HSM integration.
- Ports & flows: we prefer explicit allowlists per service; we will provide a minimal required port list and cross-check against your security team.
- Key ownership: customer KMS recommended for regulated PII. We support both external KMS and Redwood-managed keys if required by contract.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Intro call with Ben & Aditya for ops ownership (30m) — please propose times.
2) Customer to share access inventory and firewall admin contact.
3) We will supply a draft MOP and a gating checklist for your SOC2/audit artifact requests.

I've Cc'd Ben to lead the intake call. Attaching: mop-network-ports.json (port list / flow examples).

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

(Attachment stub: mop-network-ports.json — JSON with canonical port and flow recommendations)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2024 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake: network & governance overview

Kim / Aditya —

Thanks — I can take ops ownership for the kickoff. Draft checklist below (we'll convert to Drive doc for tracking):

- Pre-intake artifacts required from LumaCorp:
  * Access inventory (users, service accounts, privileged accounts) — see CSV template.
  * Firewall / NAT diagram and routing table snapshot.
  * KMS requirements and HSM hardware details (if on-prem).
  * Compliance artifacts requested: list of retention policies, expected audit window.

- Redwood deliverables pre-kickoff:
  * MOP (draft) with exact port allowlist and test plan (owner: Ben)
  * Smoke test checklist (owner: Aditya)
  * Temporary test credentials and limited-scope service account (owner: Markus)

- Quick blockers to flag now:
  1) If Luma needs egress to a managed telemetry endpoint, we need IPs whitelisted before smoke runs.
  2) KMS integration can add 3–5 business days if on-prem HSM needs rack access and CA cert exchange.

Matt — can you confirm who will own the firewall diagram and whether the edge boxes are behind a NAT? Also please upload the access inventory CSV when you can.

Ben Carter
Manager, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference
(Attachment referenced: access-inventory.csv template)

From: Matt Holmes <matt.holmes@lumacorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops+proc@lumacorp.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake: network & governance overview

Ben / Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:

- Edge boxes are behind an outbound NAT; we will provision static egress IPs for the smoke run.
- I'll assign Claire (cc'd in ops+proc) to own the firewall diagram and upload the access inventory by EOD tomorrow.
- We will want Redwood to use our KMS (Thales HSM) for encryption; Claire will share HSM model and cert details.

Also attaching a zip of the initial inventory + a filled milestone matrix from our side -> see Luma_MAP_v1.xlsx (attached).

Timeline still looks achievable; can we target a kickoff on Wed 2024-07-03 at 10:00 PT?

Matt

---
(Attachment stub: Luma_MAP_v1.xlsx — completed milestone matrix as referenced)
